en: The image shows a vintage black-and-white view of a public square with trees and benches in the foreground. In the background, there is a large stone building with classical architectural features, next to a religious structure with a bell tower and arched windows. The text identifies the location as 'Pontevedra - San-Francisco.' The image has an old-fashioned style typical of early 20th-century postcards.
